content:
Update, 7:49 p.m. ET: All issues are now marked as resolved. The original story follows below.

Apple’s System Status page confirms that consumers and developers are currently experiencing issues accessing some of its services. Here are the details.

Multiple Apple services currently down for some users

According to Apple’s System Status page, some users are seeing issues with Find My, Game Center, Photos, and iWork for iCloud, among other services,

Here’s the company’s description for each service currently experiencing issues. We are continuously updating this list, as more services become affected:

Find My – Issue


Today, 3:30 PM ET – ongoing
Some users are affected
This service may be slow or unavailable.

Game Center – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Users are experiencing a problem with Game Center. We are investigating and will update the status as more information becomes available.

Cloud Calendar – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

iWork for iCloud – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

iCloud Contacts – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

iCloud Mail – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

iCloud Web Apps (iCloud.com) – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

Photos – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

iCloud Account & Sign In – Issue


Today, 3:33 PM ET – ongoing
All users are affected
Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

Likewise, Apple’s Developer System Status page shows an Xcode Cloud outage that began at 3:59 p.m. ET. Apple says some users “are experiencing a problem with this service,” adding that it is “working to resolve the issue.” Additionally, Apple New API and News Publisher are also presenting issues.

While Apple’s system status page makes it clear that the issues are not affecting all users, reports of iCloud and Find My outages on Downdetector have been climbing for the past hour.

We’ll monitor the situation and update this post as Apple shares more details or these systems come fully back online.
